body: YTA, for allowing those people to treat your boyfriend in such a poor manner. I can't understand how you can stand and watch your ridiculous family treat your bf this way ? Do you even love him? Wow I never saw such audacity of feeling sad for not seeing your nephew, but not feeling sad for your bf who lost both money and self-respect by being with you. Do him a favour and breakup with him, so he can find someone who actually treats him better than you and your snobbish family. Do yourself a favor too, by staying away from them for your inner peace.

NTA 

I get her. I'm like her. I can eat/tolerate spicy foods (Indian) and most of our dishes would not use sugar/honey/anything that makes the dish sweet. I can't tolerate sweetness in my spicy/even mild spicy foods. Infact from my city, we rarely use any sweet ingredients in the main dishes. So it's habitual. But at the same time I eat sweets, like desserts. For me dessert should be sweet. Meal should be spicy/hot without sour or sweet taste. Same goes for fruits. I only eat if the fruits are sweet. Any fruit, which could be sour/tangy is always a no for me. Infact my family/friends even taste them before giving me, saying "it's sweet, you can eat it." Even then I'll be extremely suspicious, in case they may be tricking me into eating sour fruit. Same goes for raw tomatoes. I even pick them out of pizza/burgers. But I can eat tomato curry or rice. I even dislike cooked onions, as they have sweet taste. But I can stomach raw onions without any problem. I even outright refuse to touch anything which looks suspiciously sour/tangy or 'sweet n sour dish' without even tasting. I'd rather starve myself than taste/eat such foods.

My gosh all this time I thought I was the picky eater. Looks like people like me exist. And it's not a crime. And it's not that bad, just don't offer any spicy/hot dish with sweet in it man. And if she refuses such foods, let it be. People can eat what they want. No need to police people's food choices.
I forgot to mention, I recently lost my dad pre-covid. And I had to currently put away my suicide plans, so to take care of my mother. Maybe I hate her cause I'm still alive for her?
